newsitem.title: FRANCE: Best French barley bids $130-131 for 50,000 T.
newsitem.headline: Best French barley bids $130-131 for 50,000 T.

text.p: Thursday's lowest French refund bids for European Union barley, implying the highest world price, valued it at $130-131 for September export, traders said.
About 50,000 tonnes of barley were involved in the lowest bids for a refund of 9.50 Ecus per tonne.
Including that amount, a cumulative total of 115,000 tonnes of barley was involved in bids up to and including 11 Ecus per tonne, traders said.
Cumulative bids up to 11.50 Ecus were for 165,000 tonnes and those up to 12.50 Ecus covered a total of 296,000 tonnes.
At 14 Ecus, the cumulative total was 326,000 tonnes.
Cereals office ONIC said earlier that the total range of bids -- it does not publish a breakdown -- was for 401,000 tonnes between refunds of 9.50 and 19.47 Ecus a tonne.
